note: Real, weekly editorial Top 10 (Bill, 2026-09-25: build a modern replacement for The Ringer's old Weekly Top 10). General-audience, NOT derived from Bill's own Trakt data or BMTRE's scoring engine. Refreshed Oct 19, 2026 inside an interactive Claude Code session using its own WebSearch tool, per the standing no-API-credits policy (CLAUDE.md, "Streaming Top 10 — No-Cost Refresh"). Sources: Netflix Tudum's weekly Top 10 (Oct 5-11), FlixPatrol daily charts (Oct 18), Nielsen (Sept 28-Oct 4), TelevisionStats attention scores, and entertainment-press schedule/review coverage. Every TMDB id is real (confirmed against themoviedb.org or the existing local cache), never guessed. Every entry needs current-week evidence (a premiere, new episode, finale, or real chart position this week); shows whose season wrapped with nothing new happening (e.g. Ted Lasso, Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story) were dropped. Each show's status/predicted score/genre tags on the page are computed live from Bill's Trakt data and BMTRE, for display only.
methodology: Scored on four weighted dimensions, per Bill's own detailed brief: Audience 30% (is anyone actually watching — Nielsen minutes, JustWatch rank), Current Momentum 25% (is interest rising right now, not just sustained), Cultural Buzz 25% (is it being talked about — reviews, awards, entertainment press, viral moments), Watchability/Editorial Relevance 20% (is it actually a good recommendation this week — accessible, well-reviewed, worth starting). The raw score is an internal ranking mechanism only, never shown. Every entry keeps real, cited sources in the underlying data even though the page itself doesn't display them.

shows.title: Below
shows.whyHere: Netflix's Josh Hartnett sea-creature thriller premiered Oct 8 and was the #1 show on Netflix's global TV chart for Oct 5-11 with 17M views; FlixPatrol still had it at #1 worldwide on Oct 18.
shows.whyWatch: A tight, 6-episode creature mystery set in a Newfoundland fishing town, with Hartnett, Mackenzie Davis and Charlie Heaton. Easy to finish in a weekend.
shows.vibe: Jaws by way of a small-town family drama, in freezing North Atlantic water.

shows.title: East of Eden
